summary: Frontend-only UI/navigation smoke tests for WreckWorks (Expo Router). Verified main menu, level select (10 tiles, L1 unlocked/L2-10 locked), game screen with 3D GLView canvas mount, HUD (Score, LVL, 5 shot dots, Pause), pause overlay (Resume/Retry/Quit), and navigation back to levels/menu. All 12 required flows PASS. 3D scene visibly renders cannon, block stack, ground, sky, aim reticle.

ui_bugs.issue: 'DRAG TO AIM • RELEASE TO FIRE' hint is not visible on Level 1 first entry. hintVisible state is initialized true for levelId===1 but the hint text element was not detected in DOM (playwright text=DRAG TO AIM returned null) and not seen in screenshot. Likely rendering/z-order issue: hint uses position:absolute bottom:24 with maxWidth 380 and `marginHorizontal: 'auto' as any` (not valid RN style on web) which may collapse layout. Recommend using `left:0,right:0,alignItems:'center'` on parent or `alignSelf:'center'` instead of marginHorizontal auto.

Playwright reported '[data-testid=back-button]' resolved to 2 elements (RN Web Pressable double-render) and first was flagged 'not visible' on second visit. Non-blocking — click works via .first. Consider wrapping in single native element or adding testID only on inner element.

issues: props.pointerEvents deprecated on RN Web — use style.pointerEvents

action_items: Fix hint banner visibility on Level 1 (replace marginHorizontal:'auto' with alignSelf:'center' or use flex parent).
Migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents (game.tsx line ~98 & ~135).
Replace deprecated textShadow* individual props with unified textShadow (index.tsx title, game.tsx scoreValue).
Optionally swap THREE.Clock for THREE.Timer in GameScene.
critical_code_review_comments: progress.ts cache is a module-level singleton — completeLevel mutates but returns same reference; UI re-fetch via useFocusEffect works, but be aware cache never invalidates across hot reloads.
game.tsx: `paused || !!result` prop to GameScene freezes physics but hint state does not reset when navigating back — fine since remount by levelKey resets.
All screens correctly use React Native primitives; all interactive elements have testIDs. Good coverage.
seed_data_creation: None. AsyncStorage progress starts fresh (0/10, 0/30 stars).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landscape viewport 812x375 used. game-canvas testID is on the GLView. Physics/aim not tested (PanResponder drag not simulated). If gameplay validation needed, use mouse drag on canvas center and verify score increments + result overlay appears.
rca_of_issue: Hint not visible RCA: `marginHorizontal: 'auto' as any` is not a valid React Native style property on web and gets stripped/ignored, combined with `left:0, right:0, position:absolute, maxWidth:380` the container likely stretches to full width making inner flexDirection:row content anchor left off-viewport. Fix: remove marginHorizontal auto, add `alignSelf:'center'` OR wrap in a full-width container using justifyContent:'center'.
